Tanav ke khilaf sabse badi hathiyar humari yeh shamta hai ki hum ek vichar ko dusre par chun sakein.
"Tum apni soul ke captain ho."
"Only limit wohi—jo tum khud set karte."
Woh badlaav khud baniye jo aap duniya mein dekhna chahte hain.
Perfection nahi—progress ka strive.
Quitters kabhi win nahi.
Success hai khud ko pasand karna, jo kaam karte ho usse love karna, aur us tareeqe se pasand karna.
Perseverance sab jeet leti hai.
"Uncomfortable ke saath comfortable bano."
